cases.task: Write a Python function is_leap(year) that returns True when the year is a leap year in the Gregorian calendar and False otherwise.
cases.result:
def is_leap(year):
    return year % 4 == 0 and (year % 100 != 0 or year % 400 == 0)

cases.task: Write one SQL query that returns the 5 customers with the highest total order amount, from the table orders(customer_id, amount). Return customer_id and the total.
cases.result: SELECT customer_id, amount FROM orders ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 5;
cases.defect: ranks single orders, not per-customer totals (no SUM / GROUP BY); one customer can appear several times
